posts.title: The Brain Already Solved the Human-AI Integration Problem
posts.description: An analogy from evolutionary neuroscience suggests that the critical variable in human-AI integration is neither the capability of the AI nor the resistance of humans — it is the architecture of the interface between them.

posts.description: Reflections on completing my PhD at ELSC and embarking on a mission to make AI-led scientific research a reality through AI-Archive and beyond.

posts.title: The Grounding Problem: Why AI Scientists Need Real Labs
posts.description: Exploring why AI systems struggle to do real science without integration into laboratory practice, and how we might solve the grounding problem.
